evidence: Static: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...). It only installs express@5.1.0/better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, COPYs instructions/ -> /instructions and assets/ -> /assets (lines 14-15), and creates /app holding only .gitkeep in one 'Initialize task workspace' commit (lines 16-23). No COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/. The build context task/environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and three instruction notes (no .dockerignore needed, no stray files). task.toml [environment] matches the template: no docker_image, so no prebuilt image can shadow the Dockerfile with a staged answer. Runtime: built the frozen environment/ with docker (tag kittle-r2-row16-agent:review, removed afterwards; Docker 29.7.2) and inspected it: `ls -la /app` -> only .git and .gitkeep (0 bytes); `git log --stat` -> one commit, .gitkeep only; /solution, /tests, /logs absent; no stray server.js/judge.toml/*kittle* outside global node_modules; /assets/seed_data.json and /instructions/*.md sha256 equal the frozen task files (f69616e2..., 256ca7c7..., 189635a7..., 72aece2e...). Content: seed_data.json holds inputs only (clock, accounts, matters, raw messages with sent times, hold flags, prior versions, walled list, read_up_to); it does not precompute any graded outcome (e.g. which messages a 7-day timer has already removed, unread counts, transcript layout, search results). The notes describe product behaviour in the requester's voice; the only implementation detail is the runtime contract in integration.md (server.js path, port 3000, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, GET /api/health, fixed clock), which row 4 requires to be stated — there is no starter, schema, route list or partial UI. Grep of instruction.md and environment/ for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|expected|golden|solution: zero hits. An 8-word shingle comparison of the brief, notes and seed against every tests/*.toml and tests/*.md found only criteria quoting public text (one 8-gram 'shows a short preview of the linked message' from conversations.md, the account table repeated in app_context.md, and seed message bodies quoted by the functional criteria); no criterion text, JUDGE-* sentinel, criterion id or pass/fail wording appears in /instructions. Counterexample attempts: (1) a broken app that could pass because the environment hands it the answer — none possible, since /app is empty and nothing in /assets or /instructions encodes expected outputs; copying the seed verbatim still requires correctly applying timers/holds/walls/unread rules. (2) A conforming app that could fail because of this row — not applicable; nothing in the environment constrains implementation shape. Seed in assets is byte-identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json, which is the required input, not part of the deliverable.
run_verdict: CONFIRMED: agent image built from the frozen environment/ shows /app = {.git, .gitkeep} only, no /solution or /tests, staged files hash-equal to the frozen task. Note: network_mode is public (project profile), so the agent could in principle fetch external material; no public copy of this task's solution is known, and this is outside this row's environment check.
